The '''2017–18 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team's [[head coach]] was [[Roy Williams (coach)|Roy Williams]], who was in his 15th season as UNC's head men's basketball coach. The Tar Heels played their home games at the [[Dean Smith Center]] in [[Chapel Hill, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 26–11, 11–7 in [[2017–18 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a four-way tie for fourth place. As the No. 6 seed in the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]], [[2017–18 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]], and [[2017–18 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] before losing to [[2017–18 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] in the championship game. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the West region where they defeated [[2017–18 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Lipscomb]] before losing to [[2017–18 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] in the Second Round.
